items.exampleEn: The homework is due on Friday.
There are twenty students in the class.
My mother is thirty years old.
The bus comes in fifteen minutes.

items.sentenceEn: My homework is due in fifteen minutes!
items.sentenceZh: 我的功課再十五分鐘就要交了！

items.audioEn: I bought this coat yesterday. It was fifty dollars.
items.audioZh: 我昨天買了這件外套，它五十美元。

items.sentenceEn: There are thirty days in this month.
My sister is twenty, and I am twelve.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊二十歲，我十二歲。

items.stemEn: The library book is ____ on Monday.
items.stemZh: 圖書館的書星期一到期。

items.passageEn: Yesterday was March 12. It was my father's birthday. He is fifty now. Twenty people came to our home for dinner. We had a big cake and a lot of fun. Everyone went home at twelve at night.
items.passageZh: 昨天是三月十二日，是我爸爸的生日，他現在五十歲了。有二十個人來我們家吃晚餐。我們吃了一個大蛋糕，玩得很開心。大家半夜十二點才回家。

questions.questionZh: 有多少人來家裡吃晚餐？

referenceEn: This homework is due on Wednesday.
rubricZh: 「⋯要交、到期」用 be due（例如 is due on Wednesday）
星期前例如用 on（寫 by Wednesday 也正確）
昨天的事用過去式（例如 rained）
「一整天」可寫，例如 all day 等
